entries.title: Psalms 106:1
segments: Praise the LORD. O give thanks to the LORD; for [He is] good; for His mercy [endures] forever.

entries.title: Psalms 106:2
segments: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD, or cause all His praise to be heard?

entries.title: Psalms 106:3
segments: Blessed [are] those who keep judgment, he who does righteousness at all times.

entries.title: Psalms 106:4
segments: Remember me, O LORD, with the favor of Your people; O visit me with Your salvation,

entries.title: Psalms 106:5
segments: that I may see the good of Your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, to glory with Your inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 106:6
segments: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

entries.title: Psalms 106:7
segments: Our fathers did not understand Your wonders in Egypt; they did not remember the multitude of Your mercies, but rebelled at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

entries.title: Psalms 106:8
segments: But He saved them for His name's sake, to make His mighty power known.

entries.title: Psalms 106:9
segments: And He rebuked the Red Sea, and it was dried up; so He led them through the depths, [as] through the wilderness.

entries.title: Psalms 106:10
segments: And He saved them from the hand of the hater, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

entries.title: Psalms 106:11
segments: And the waters covered their enemies; there was not one of them left.

entries.title: Psalms 106:12
segments: Then they believed His words; they sang His praise.

entries.title: Psalms 106:13
segments: They hurried [and] forgot His works; they did not wait for His counsel;

entries.title: Psalms 106:14
segments: but they lusted greedily in the wilderness, and tested God in the desert.

entries.title: Psalms 106:15
segments: And He gave them what they asked, but sent leanness into their soul.

entries.title: Psalms 106:16
segments: And they were jealous of Moses in the camp, [and] Aaron the saint of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 106:17
segments: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

entries.title: Psalms 106:18
segments: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 106:19
segments: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped the melted image.

entries.title: Psalms 106:20
segments: And they changed their Glory into the likeness of an ox that eats grass.

entries.title: Psalms 106:21
segments: They forgot God their Deliverer, who had done great things in Egypt;

entries.title: Psalms 106:22
segments: wonderful works in the land of Ham, fearful things by the Red Sea.

entries.title: Psalms 106:23
segments: And He said that He would destroy them, if Moses His chosen had not stood before Him in the breach, to turn away His wrath, so that He should not destroy [them].

entries.title: Psalms 106:24
segments: And they despised the pleasant land; they did not believe His word,

entries.title: Psalms 106:25
segments: but murmured in their tents, [and] did not listen to the voice of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 106:26
segments: And He lifted up His hand to them, to overthrow them in the wilderness;

entries.title: Psalms 106:27
segments: to overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.

entries.title: Psalms 106:28
segments: And they joined themselves to Baal-peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead,

entries.title: Psalms 106:29
segments: and provoked [Him] to anger with their doings; and the plague broke in on them.

entries.title: Psalms 106:30
segments: Then Phinehas stood and interceded, and the plague was stayed.

entries.title: Psalms 106:31
segments: And it was counted to him for righteousness to all generations forevermore.

entries.title: Psalms 106:32
segments: And they angered [Him] at the waters of strife so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes;

entries.title: Psalms 106:33
segments: because they provoked his spirit so that he spoke rashly with his lips.

entries.title: Psalms 106:34
segments: They did not destroy the nations [as] the LORD commanded them;

entries.title: Psalms 106:35
segments: but were mixed among the nations, and learned their works.

entries.title: Psalms 106:36
segments: And they served their idols, which were a snare to them.

entries.title: Psalms 106:37
segments: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons,

entries.title: Psalms 106:38
segments: and shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan; and the land was defiled with blood.

entries.title: Psalms 106:39
segments: And they were defiled with their works, and went lusting in their doings.

entries.title: Psalms 106:40
segments: And the wrath of the LORD was kindled against His people, and He detested His inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 106:41
segments: And He gave them into the hand of the nations; and those who hated them ruled over them.

entries.title: Psalms 106:42
segments: And their enemies oppressed them, and they were humbled under their hand.

entries.title: Psalms 106:43
segments: Many times He delivered them, but they rebelled in their counsel and sank in their iniquities.

entries.title: Psalms 106:44
segments: And He looked on their affliction when He heard their cry;

entries.title: Psalms 106:45
segments: and He remembered [His] covenant for them, and was moved to pity, according to the multitude of His mercies.

entries.title: Psalms 106:46
segments: And He gave them to tender mercies before the face of all their captors.

entries.title: Psalms 106:47
segments: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to Your holy name [and] to triumph in Your praise.

entries.title: Psalms 106:48
segments: Blessed [is] the LORD God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting; and let all the people say, Amen. Praise the LORD!
